description: This file defines a JPA entity class 'Publisher' representing a publisher in a book management system; it includes fields for id and name, and manages a many-to-many relationship with books.

classes.name: Publisher
classes.description: Entity class representing a book publisher with a unique name and an associated set of books.

methods.name: Publisher
methods.description: Constructor initializing Publisher with a name.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the publisher's name as its string representation.

methods.description: Checks equality based on the publisher's name.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the publisher's name.
